notes: Posted 25 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards (the strategy calls Crush The Rebellion the best effect 'pre-coruscant'), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under The Start...: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Holotheatre, Meditation Chamber, Visage, Podrace Arena, Start Your Engines, Epic Duel, Crush The Rebellion, Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Pod; these count toward the 60.
'Visage x3' is posted under Interrupts; it is Visage Of The Emperor (the strategy says Visage should be listed under Effects), giving 4 in total with the starting copy.

Posted 'Choke Vader' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader w/ Stick' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Thrawn' Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Janus' Janus Greejatus; 'Elis Herlot' Elis Helrot; 'Omni Box/It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.
Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Cantina, Lar's Moisture Farm and Audience Chamber dested the Dark pages.
Posted 'Effect from Tatooine That Adds to Deploy Cost of Aliens on Tatooine' dested His Name Is Anakin (Tatooine set; opponent's aliens deploy +1 on Tatooine).
'Grabber' names no card and is printed as written.
No Escape is the Jabba's Palace Effect (the Reflections III shield came later).
"Duel Destiny Adder (I Forget the Name)" is printed as posted; the poster did not name the card (Focused Attack is the likeliest pre-Coruscant match).
